# Graveyard Keeper 2 Wiki

> An unofficial player-made wiki for Graveyard Keeper 2: the console-commands and cheats truth, beginner guides, and troubleshooting for every progression blocker. Verified and dated after every game update.

Wiki for Graveyard Keeper 2 (PC (Steam), by Lazy Bear Games). Articles cover boss guides, tier lists, codes, items, and beginner tips.

## Articles

- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Achievements — All 38, With Conditions](https://gk2wiki.com/achievements/all-achievements/): Graveyard Keeper 2 has 38 achievements — 39 trophies with the Platinum on PlayStation. Every condition below is quoted from the platform trophy text, the five Steam hides included; the 15 visible story beats are separated from the 18 grind counters, and the one place the Steam and PlayStation lists differ is flagged. Corrected October 17, 2026.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Cheats & Console Commands (October 2026) — The Truth](https://gk2wiki.com/codes/all-codes/): No working text codes or built-in console commands have been documented for Graveyard Keeper 2 as of version 1.010 (October 2026). The real speed-ups are the automation economy: zombie workers, factory lines, and church income. This page proves the claim, explains what to do instead, and is re-checked after every game update.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Fishing — All 22 Fish, Bait and Spots](https://gk2wiki.com/guides/fishing-guide/): Graveyard Keeper 2 has 22 fish across six spots — Inquisition Base, Village, Forest, Port Area, Swamp and Sewers — and four baits: none, Breadcrumb, Insect and Live. This page lists every fish with bait, spot, best time, fight difficulty and buyer, plus the four legendary catches no trader buys.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Prayers & Sermons — All 26, With Yields and Buffs](https://gk2wiki.com/guides/prayers-and-sermons-guide/): Graveyard Keeper 2 has 26 prayers and 58 sermon tiers. Attendance is the lower of town happiness and church quality; success chance is parishioners times 100 divided by the sermon's Guaranteed value, capped at 100 percent. This page lists every prayer and tier with its unlock and yields, plus the best pick for Faith, money and success bonuses.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Tools — Every Tier, Cost and Mastery Bonus](https://gk2wiki.com/guides/tools-and-upgrades/): Graveyard Keeper 2 has 32 tools across nine disciplines, and every one follows the same ladder: Rusty +1 mastery, Bronze +2, Iron +4, Steel +6 while in the tool belt. This page lists every tier with its recipe and price, plus the tool requirements that gate zombie stations.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Factory Automation Guide — Conveyors and Iron](https://gk2wiki.com/guides/factory-automation-guide/): The underground factory turns the manual grind into a conveyor-fed supply chain. This guide walks the full unlock path, your first Zombie Carousel, the iron run to the town warehouse, and a checklist for the moment the line stops — because at some point, it will stop.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Faith Guide — Earning It and Spending It](https://gk2wiki.com/guides/faith-guide/): Faith in Graveyard Keeper 2 funds Inspiration, zombie creation and some fast travel — and it is the resource players run out of first. This guide explains how sermons and prayers generate it, why early faith feels slow, and which spending is worth the wait.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Money Guide — What Actually Earns Coin](https://gk2wiki.com/guides/money-guide/): Coin in Graveyard Keeper 2 comes from four streams that scale: village crops, the paint production chain, town merchant orders, and church income. This guide explains how each one unlocks, which to build first, and the busywork that only looks like profit once energy is your scarce resource.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Zombie Workers Guide — Tasks, Setups and Fixes](https://gk2wiki.com/guides/zombie-workers-guide/): Zombie workers are the real speed-up: unlock them via the Plague Doctor's Sweet Dreams quest, prepare a corpse with five red skulls, then staff lumber, quarry and farm stations so the dead do the work your energy used to. This guide covers every setup, the tool requirements, and the fixes for idle zombies.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Beginner Guide — Your First Days in the Yard](https://gk2wiki.com/guides/beginner-guide/): Graveyard Keeper 2 runs on three engines: the graveyard-and-church pair that converts corpses into faith and money, the tech tree that unlocks the town and the Royal Foundry, and the automation economy of zombie workers and factory lines. This guide explains each engine, the order to build them in, and the mistakes that stall new keepers.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Troubleshooting — Steel, the Foundry & Blockers](https://gk2wiki.com/guides/troubleshooting/): The Graveyard Keeper 2 progression blockers players hit most: steel and the Royal Foundry tech line, Polished Bronze and Bronze Detail, orders with Jack and the warehouse, faith income, and zombie mining. Each blocker below explains where the answer lives in-game and what typically unsticks it — checked against version 1.008.
- [Blue Crystal — Graveyard Keeper 2: Where to Get It (Collars Need It)](https://gk2wiki.com/items/blue-crystal/): Blue Crystal comes from Gunter at 75 bronze, or from a pile of four that appears by the Goddess of Nature statue in the Swamp at the start of every Envy day after Heart of the Swamp. It is the ingredient every zombie collar needs, which makes it a hard cap on your workforce until the swamp loop runs.
- [Iron Ore — Graveyard Keeper 2: Where to Get It & What It's For](https://gk2wiki.com/items/iron-ore/): Iron Ore comes from 28 deposits across the map at 3 per node with Smithing mastery 3, or passively from a Zombie Miner that turns 1 Iron Ore and 2 Coal into 8 ticks of ore. It feeds Iron Ingots, Golden nuggets and eight alchemy formulas, which makes it the ore to automate first.
- [Marble — Graveyard Keeper 2: Where to Get It & What It's For](https://gk2wiki.com/items/marble/): Marble is scarce on purpose: five deposits of four each, gated behind Building mastery 4 to 7, or a Zombie Marble Quarry for passive output. It goes into Marble Kits, Sculpture Kit II and Marble Plates — the decorative chain that pushes graveyard quality toward the 200 target.
- [Zombie Goo — Graveyard Keeper 2: Where to Get It and What It Brews](https://gk2wiki.com/items/zombie-goo/): Zombie Goo drops six at a time from won battles — 24 battles pay it, starting with Break Through to the Port — and Gunter sells it for 1 silver 50 bronze. It is a pure blue-rune carrier used in ten alchemy formulas, so bank a stack before your first Laboratory II session.
- [Dream Dust — Graveyard Keeper 2 Recipe, Runes & Cheapest Mix](https://gk2wiki.com/items/dream-dust/): Dream Dust is the cheapest useful brew in Graveyard Keeper 2 — 1 green and 1 blue rune, twenty two-ingredient combinations, and a 68–72 bronze price if you would rather buy it. It unlocks the first zombies through Sweet Dreams and is one of three ingredients the fairy summoning needs.
- [Organ Improver — Graveyard Keeper 2 Recipe (Red & White Skull Versions)](https://gk2wiki.com/items/organ-improver/): Organ Improver is really two formulas under one name: 4 red + 1 green converts an organ into its gold red-skull version, and 4 green converts it into the white-skull version. Both are used at the Formulation Bench. The cheapest red mix is Copper Nugget + Red Mushroom; the cheapest white mix is Swamp mushroom + Swamp mushroom.
- [Paint — Graveyard Keeper 2 Recipe, Runes & Cheapest Mix (Money Line)](https://gk2wiki.com/items/paint-recipe/): Paint is a 2-green-rune formula, and the cheapest mixes are literally Berry + Berry or Leaf + Leaf — resources you already throw away. The Alchemist, Trademaster and Furniture Maker buy it from level 3, and the combination step costs no energy, which is what makes it a reliable early income line.
- [Philosopher Stone — Graveyard Keeper 2 Recipe & Gold Conversion](https://gk2wiki.com/items/philosopher-stone/): Philosopher Stone is the only formula that needs three of every rune, which forces Laboratory II. At the Formulation Bench it converts one Iron Ore into a Golden nugget, or one Iron Ingot into a Golden ingot, and the Alchemist pays about 35 silver for a spare. The cheapest documented mix is Cheese + Cheese + Cheese.
- [Reanimation Liquid — Graveyard Keeper 2 Recipe, Runes & Cheapest Mix](https://gk2wiki.com/items/reanimation-liquid/): Reanimation Liquid needs exactly 2 red, 1 green and 4 blue runes at Laboratory II, and every zombie revival consumes one. The cheapest documented mix is Tin + Peat + Night flower. This page covers the runes, every cheap mix, where those ingredients come from, and how far one batch stretches your workforce.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Alchemy Cheat Sheet — Runes, Formulas, Ingredients](https://gk2wiki.com/items/alchemy-runes-cheat-sheet/): Alchemy in Graveyard Keeper 2 is arithmetic, not recipes: every ingredient carries red, green and blue rune values, and a brew works only when the totals match a formula exactly. This cheat sheet carries all 28 formula entries, all 63 ingredients with where to get each one, and the lab rules the game never explains — cross-checked against two independent datasets.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Main Quest Walkthrough — All 7 Acts in Order](https://gk2wiki.com/quests/main-quest-walkthrough/): Graveyard Keeper 2 runs 41 journal quests across seven acts, book-ended by an unjournaled prologue: the prison escape, Larry, the sewers and your first burial. This walkthrough lists every act in order with its quest names, the reputation and quality gates that stall progress, and the weekday locks the game explains nowhere.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Patch Notes — Every Update, Dated](https://gk2wiki.com/updates/patch-notes/): This page tracks every Graveyard Keeper 2 update since the September 22 launch, in one dated log: what each version fixed, what it rebalanced, which progression bugs died, and what the developers have publicly planned next. Re-checked after every patch — the same promise as our codes page.
